author: Stephan Jacobs
title: UBS Analysts Give Apple (AAPL) a $190.00 Price Target
text:
UBS Analysts Give Apple (AAPL) a $190.00 Price Target Posted by Stephan Jacobs | May 23rd, 2018
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) has been assigned a $190.00 price target by UBS in a research note issued on Tuesday, May 1st, www.boersen-zeitung.de reports. The firm presently has a “buy” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. UBS’s price objective would indicate a potential upside of 0.87% from the stock’s current price.
A number of other equities research analysts also recently issued reports on the stock. DA Davidson began coverage on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, April 30th. They set a “buy” rating and a $220.00 price target on the stock. Barclays decreased their price target on shares of Apple from $168.00 to $157.00 and set an “equal weight” rating on the stock in a research note on Monday, April 30th. Sanford C. Bernstein reiterated a “neutral” rating and set a $170.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Thursday, April 26th. Deutsche Bank set a $152.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research report on Tuesday, April 24th. Finally, Wells Fargo & Co restated a “hold” rating and issued a $195.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, April 24th. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-one have given a buy rating and two have assigned a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company presently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $204.74. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of Apple traded up $1.20, hitting $188.36, during mid-day trading on Tuesday, MarketBeat Ratings reports. The company had a trading volume of 19,522,298 shares, compared to its average volume of 35,138,246. Apple has a 52-week low of $142.20 and a 52-week high of $190.37. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80, a quick ratio of 1.37 and a current ratio of 1.46. The company has a market capitalization of $952.04 billion, a PE ratio of 20.45, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.39 and a beta of 1.26.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 EPS for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. The firm had revenue of $61.14 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $60.94 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the firm earned $2.10 earnings per share. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 15.6% compared to the same quarter last year. research analysts predict that Apple will post 11.43 EPS for the current fiscal year.
Apple declared that its Board of Directors has authorized a share repurchase plan on Tuesday, May 1st that permits the company to repurchase $100.00 billion in outstanding shares. This repurchase authorization permits the iPhone maker to reacquire up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock repurchase plans are often a sign that the company’s board believes its stock is undervalued.
In other news, SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Wednesday, April 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total transaction of $2,938,460.00. Following the transaction, the senior vice president now owns 66,191 shares in the company, valued at approximately $11,194,221.92. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through this hyperlink . Also, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 15,653 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Tuesday, May 8th. The stock was sold at an average price of $185.18, for a total value of $2,898,622.54. Following the transaction, the chief operating officer now owns 168,181 shares in the company, valued at approximately $31,143,757.58. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold a total of 237,108 shares of company stock worth $41,663,055 in the last 90 days. 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by insiders.
Several hedge funds and other institutional investors have recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. Quad Cities Investment Group LLC purchased a new stake in Apple in the 1st quarter valued at about $5,017,000. Edmonds Duncan Registered Investment Advisors LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 11.9% in the 1st quarter. Edmonds Duncan Registered Investment Advisors LLC now owns 8,981 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,517,000 after buying an additional 956 shares during the period. BDO Wealth Advisors LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 7.2% in the 1st quarter. BDO Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 17,915 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,006,000 after buying an additional 1,201 shares during the period. Equitec Specialists LLC purchased a new stake in Apple in the 1st quarter valued at about $319,000. Finally, Amalgamated Bank raised its holdings in Apple by 9.6% in the 1st quarter. Amalgamated Bank now owns 744,589 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $124,927,000 after buying an additional 65,118 shares during the period. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 58.19% of the company’s stock.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
